Dungeon Breakout

Dungeon Breakout privacy policy

Effective date: 29 October 2026
Developer: Versound Games ("we", "us")
Contact: versoundgames@gmail.com

This policy explains what information the Dungeon Breakout game collects, why, and the choices you have. It covers the Android app (Google Play) and the web version (itch.io).

Summary

  • The game has no accounts. We never ask for your name, email address, contacts, photos or precise location.
  • Your progress (levels, stars, coins, spells) is stored only on your device.
  • The Android app shows optional rewarded ads (Google AdMob), sells optional in-app items (Google Play Billing), and measures gameplay with GameAnalytics. These services receive device and usage information, described below.
  • There is no cloud save: we cannot see or restore your progress, and it is not backed up by us.
  • The web version has no ads, no purchases and no analytics.

Information stored on your device

The game saves your progress in a local file on your device, and your sound and haptics settings in a second one. Nothing is uploaded. The save holds: levels cleared and stars, coins, spell charges and unlocks, which creature introductions you have seen, how many times each creature escaped (bestiary), how many free spell charges you claimed today, your daily-room results and streak, and identifiers of purchases already credited (so a purchase is never credited twice). This data does not leave your device through us. To delete it, uninstall the app, or clear its storage (Android: Settings → Apps → Dungeon Breakout → Storage → Clear data; web version: clear the site data for the page in your browser).

Advertising: Google AdMob (Android only)

The Android app offers rewarded ads that you choose to watch (for example to continue a level or double your coins). There are no other ads. Ads are provided by Google AdMob through the Google Mobile Ads SDK, which is built into the app. When an ad is requested or shown, Google may collect and process:

  • your device's advertising ID and other device identifiers,
  • your IP address, from which an approximate location (such as the country) can be derived,
  • device and app information (model, operating system, language, app version) and diagnostic data,
  • how you interact with ads.

Google uses this to show ads, measure them, prevent fraud and, where you allow it, personalise ads.

Consent: if you are in the European Economic Area, the UK or Switzerland, the app asks for your consent with Google's consent form (User Messaging Platform) before any ad is requested. You can withdraw or change that choice at any time in the game under Settings → Privacy & consent, which re-opens the form (this entry appears only where the form applies). Everywhere, you can limit ad personalisation and reset or delete your advertising ID in your Android settings (Settings → Privacy → Ads, or Google → Ads, depending on the device).

More: How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services and the Google Privacy Policy.

Purchases: Google Play Billing (Android only)

In-app purchases (packs of in-game coins) are optional and are processed entirely by Google Play through the Google Play Billing Library. We never see or store your payment card or bank details. To credit your purchase, the game receives from Google Play the product bought, the order details and a purchase token. Google's handling of payment data is described in the Google Payments Privacy Notice and the Google Privacy Policy.

Analytics: GameAnalytics (Android only)

To understand how players progress and to improve the game (for example which levels are too hard, and how many players come back after one and seven days), the Android app sends gameplay events through the GameAnalytics SDK to GameAnalytics ApS, which processes them for us. Analytics does not run in the web version, and does not run on older 32-bit Android devices. The data includes:

  • events such as a level started, completed or failed (with the level number and stars), spells used, rewarded ads watched, and purchases (product, price and the Google Play receipt, so GameAnalytics can check it is genuine),
  • session start and length,
  • device information (model, operating system version, app version, language),
  • a random identifier created by GameAnalytics and, where available, the advertising ID,
  • your IP address, used to derive the country.

GameAnalytics' own policy: gameanalytics.com/privacy.

The analytics SDK starts together with the app and does not wait for the consent form, which controls advertising. There is currently no switch in the game to turn analytics off; to stop it, uninstall the app. We do not send your name, email address or any account data, because the game does not have any.

Children

Dungeon Breakout is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from them. The game is rated for players 13 and older on Google Play. If you believe a child has used the app and data was collected, contact us and we will help delete it.

How long data is kept

We do not run servers that store your data, and your progress stays on your device until you delete it. Data held by Google (AdMob, Google Play) and GameAnalytics is kept according to their policies, linked above.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR in the EU/UK or the CCPA/CPRA in California), you may have the right to access, correct or delete personal data, to object to or restrict its processing, and to withdraw consent. Because the game has no accounts, we can't identify you from your email address. To make a request, email versoundgames@gmail.com. For analytics data we will ask GameAnalytics to delete the data linked to your device's identifiers; for advertising data you can also use Google's controls linked above. You can stop all collection at any time by uninstalling the app. You may also complain to your local data protection authority.

We do not sell your personal information for money. Advertising on the Android app is provided by Google, which receives the information described above; you can limit this with the controls described under Advertising.

Web version

The web version on itch.io contains no ads, purchases or analytics code, and saves progress only in your browser's local storage on your device. itch.io, which hosts it, has its own privacy policy.

Changes

If this policy changes, we will update the effective date above and, for significant changes, mention it in the game's release notes.

Contact
